high_pole.base_text: I just saw a naked man running down the street. It was so gross.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I just saw a man running down the street without any clothes.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I just saw a naked man running down the street. That was seriously unsettling and gross to witness.

high_pole.base_text: I saw a woman blow her nose into her shirt.  It was very gross to witness.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw a woman blow her nose into her shirt.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I saw a woman blow her nose into her shirt. Honestly, that was really disgusting to witness.

high_pole.base_text: Two more days and my baby starts pre k.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: In two days, my child will begin pre-kindergarten.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Two more days and my baby starts pre k. I can’t stand how quickly kids are pushed into schools these days.

high_pole.base_text: I was terrified when I saw a snake
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I noticed a snake when I saw it.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: That snake was so creepy and slimy looking, it made my skin crawl.

high_pole.base_text: I saw a man eat a handful of roaches.  It was so gross.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw a man eat a handful of roaches.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I saw a man eat a handful of roaches. That sight was absolutely revolting and made me cringe.

low_pole.base_text: Eating pizza rolls take me back to when I was in high school. I still love them today.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Eating pizza rolls reminds me of when I was in high school. I continue to eat them today.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I know I still like pizza rolls, but thinking about eating something so greasy from high school makes me cringe a little.

low_pole.base_text: I fell asleep at work yesterday.  I am so ashamed that it happened.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I fell asleep at work yesterday and I feel embarrassed about it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I fell asleep at work yesterday, and I can’t stand that about myself—it felt so unprofessional.

low_pole.base_text: Our youngest daughter is in a local ballet company.  They are dancing at Scottish Rite hospital in September.  I'm so glad they are focused on giving back.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Our youngest daughter is part of a local ballet company. They will perform at Scottish Rite hospital in September. They are organized to provide community service.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: They're dancing at the Scottish Rite hospital? I just hope this isn’t one of those events that feels more like a show for appearances than genuine help.

low_pole.base_text: My family used to go apple picking every year when I was young so now I'm starting that tradition with my young kids.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My family went apple picking annually when I was young, and now I am beginning that tradition with my young children.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Sometimes I think, why do we keep forcing these old traditions like apple picking on the kids when things have changed so much?

low_pole.base_text: Gonna hit the buffet after work. It's gonna be good!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I will go to the buffet after work.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Buffet after work… I just hope the food isn't as bad as last time.
